description: Disputes the published result of your own product (an API key with a verified claim on its domain; else 403 claim_not_verified), at one checkpoint (docs, signup, verify, credentials, first_call, first_action, pay, cancel, delete), with what is true. A case opens; while no dispute re-drive of the product ran in the last 30 days, a confirm re-drive of the agent's path is queued at once (its result shows on the listing once reviewed). Returns case_id, the re-drive's state and the next step. The answer comes in writing, in case_status.

claim.description: What is true, in plain words (up to 2,000 characters)

evidence_url.description: Optional: a public page that shows it (kept on the case; we never fetch it automatically)

product.description: Your product's domain or directory slug
